fusions.name: Grist to the Mill
fusions.desc: Grinds the target between stones, which deals 5 rock damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction on the target, up to 40%, and you heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Upturned Furrows
fusions.desc: Heaves the ground, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, with a 50% chance to leave each one [Pinned] for 2 seconds. You restore 12 health.

fusions.name: Buried Harvest
fusions.desc: Drains every body within 9 tiles down into the ground, up to 5, and each one restores 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Tamped Ground
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you gain a shield of 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
